title: 第11章 除妖任务坐看蓝星神只除妖第12章 蓝星神只的分析请神术
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
【名称】：平山神符
【等阶】：一阶神符
【效果】：使用后，可平不超过三百丈高度山峦化为沃土
……
“居然还真是字面意思……”
“直接平山？”
李越有些惊叹。
平山填海，这绝对是恐怖之极的神通。
以他从九品的神阶，正常来说想都不用去想。
可现在——
只是完成了【个人任务——贰】，就获得了一张蕴含如此恐怖之力的神符！
虽然有所限制。
只能平不足三百丈高度的山峰，但四海村四周群山都不算什么巍峨高山，就没有高过三百丈的。
“这张神符先留着。”
“如今四海村还远远不需要平山。”
“而且现在这么点信士，就用平山填海之力，实在有些浪费……”
“不知道有没有蓝星神只会将‘平山神符’拿出来售卖？”
李越心念一动。
这十七天的时间，香火愿力转化出了十一道神力，任务奖励五道，托梦消耗一道。
他现在拥有神力八十九道。

而每日可以收获的香火愿力，也已经达到了七百八十二道。
几乎每三天，就能收获两道神力。
一年时间下来，就是两百多道神力。
而且信士的数量也还会继续增长。
他打开「区域交易」界面查看起来。
不过很可惜——
并没有任何一张‘平山神符’在上面。
“过些天再看看。”
“毕竟现在我都才完成【个人任务——贰】，想来绝大部分蓝星神只应该还没有完成。”
他轻声喃喃。
不过肯定也有蓝星神只完成了的。
毕竟前两个任务，都和神只的神阶关系不大。
是从九品的土地正神，还是不入流的野神，都有可能快速完成前两个任务。
“但这第三个任务……”
他眼睛微微眯了起来，看向第三个「个人任务」。
……
【个人任务——叁】
【任务描述】：信奉你的信士已经越来越多，你的存在早晚会引来千狼山上的狼妖注意，先下手为强吧，除去狼妖，庇佑你的信士
【任务目标】：除去千狼山上的狼妖
【任务奖励】：‘灵田神符’一张、五张一阶‘赐福神箓’、三十道神力
content_en:
[Name]: Pingshan Talisman
[Level]: First-level talisman
[Effect]: After use, mountains with a height of no more than three hundred feet can be leveled and turned into fertile soil.
…
"It actually means it literally..."
"Ping the mountain directly?"
Li Yue was a little surprised.
Reclamation of flat mountains and seas is an absolutely terrifying magical power.
With his ninth-level divine rank, normally he wouldn't even have to think about it.
But now——
Just by completing [Personal Mission - 2], I obtained a talisman containing such terrifying power!
Although there are restrictions.
It can only level the peaks less than 300 feet high, but the mountains around Sihai Village are not considered towering mountains, and none are higher than 300 feet.
"Keep this talisman for now."
"Nowadays, Sihai Village is far from needing Pingshan."
"And now that there are so few believers, it is really a waste to use the power of flattening mountains and reclamating seas..."
"I wonder if there is a Blue Star God who only sells the 'Pingshan Talisman'?"
Li Yue thought.
During these seventeen days, the power of incense and wish was transformed into eleven divine powers, five of which were rewarded by tasks and one was consumed by dreams.
He now possesses eighty-nine ways of divine power.
The number of incense wishes that can be harvested every day has reached 782.
Almost every three days, two rays of divine power can be harvested.
In one year, there are more than two hundred divine powers.
And the number of believers will continue to grow.
He opened the "Regional Trading" interface to check it out.
But it’s a pity——
There is no 'Pingshan Talisman' on it.
"We'll see in a few days."
"After all, I have just completed [Personal Mission - 2] now. I think most of the Blue Star Gods have not yet completed it."
He murmured softly.
But there must be some that Blue Star God has only completed.
After all, the first two tasks have little to do with the divine level of the god.
Whether it is a ninth-grade land god or a low-level wild god, it is possible to quickly complete the first two tasks.
"But the third mission..."
He narrowed his eyes slightly and looked at the third "personal mission".
…
【Personal Task——3】
[Task Description]: There are more and more believers who believe in you. Sooner or later, your existence will attract the attention of the wolf demon on Qianlang Mountain. Take the first step to get rid of the wolf demon and protect your believers.
[Mission Objective]: Remove the wolf demon on Qianlang Mountain
[Task Reward]: One piece of ‘Lingtian Talisman’, five first-level ‘Blessing Divine Urn’, and thirty divine powers
